<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="xpath" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="cart"><items><item/><item/></items></data>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <onentry>
      <assign location="$cart/items/item[1]" type="delete" expr="'ignored'"/>
      <assign location="$cart/items/item" type="delete"><ignored/></assign>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="done"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>
